selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline state before change (node1 /tmp and /dev/shm mount options, fstab)
selected_evidence.summary: Showed /tmp had no dedicated mount (part of root xfs) and /dev/shm was tmpfs with only nosuid,nodev; no fstab entries for either; tmp.mount unit disabled and dev-shm.mount unit did not exist.

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent fstab configuration adding noexec,nosuid,nodev to /tmp and /dev/shm
selected_evidence.summary: Appended tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm to /etc/fstab with defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec, then applied them live; findmnt confirmed both mounts carry nosuid,nodev,noexec.

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof that exec and setuid are ignored on /tmp and /dev/shm (pre-reboot)
selected_evidence.summary: Chmod +x scripts in /tmp and /dev/shm both failed with Permission denied (rc 126); a setuid-copied binary in /tmp retained the 4755 bit on disk, which nosuid causes the kernel to ignore at exec time.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline / boot identity for node1
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id d052eb57-c81d-4309-ae7f-bce362073ff9 and confirmed mounts were healthy immediately before reboot.
systemctl reboot issued via backgrounded/disowned command; connection dropped as expected, proving the reboot command was accepted and executed before disconnecting the session.

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving node1 actually restarted
selected_evidence.summary: Two poll attempts failed while the node was down (timeout, connection reset); the third succeeded and returned boot_id 0c9068e8-f9a7-4949-ae13-78b67226f8da, different from the pre-reboot value, proving a genuine restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of the hardened mount configuration and enforcement on node1
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, findmnt showed /tmp and /dev/shm both automatically remounted via fstab with nosuid,nodev,noexec, and freshly created executable scripts in both locations again failed to run with Permission denied (rc 126), confirming persistence across reboot.

[Unit]
Description=Temporary Directory /tmp
Documentation=https://systemd.io/TEMPORARY_DIRECTORIES
Documentation=man:file-hierarchy(7)
Documentation=https://systemd.io/API_FILE_SYSTEMS
ConditionPathIsSymbolicLink=!/tmp
DefaultDependencies=no
Conflicts=umount.target
Before=local-fs.target umount.target
After=swap.target

[Mount]
What=tmpfs
Where=/tmp
Type=tmpfs
Options=mode=1777,strictatime,nosuid,nodev,size=50%%,nr_inodes=1m

# Make 'systemctl enable tmp.mount' work:
[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
